query: with target_lessons as (select s.name as series_name,c.title as chapter_title,c.is_active as chapter_active,l.id,l.title as lesson_title,l.is_active as lesson_active,coalesce(length(l.content),0) as content_length from public.lessons l join public.chapters c on c.id=l.chapter_id join public.course_subject_offerings o on o.id=c.subject_offering_id join public.subjects sub on sub.id=o.subject_id join public.levels lv on lv.id=o.level_id join public.series s on s.id=o.series_id where sub.name='Sciences de la Vie et de la Terre' and lv.name='Terminale' and s.name in ('A1','A2') and ((c.title='Thème : La communication dans l’organisme.' and l.title in ('Leçon 1 : Les réactions émotionnelles chez l’Homme.','Leçon 2 : L’activité cérébrale chez l’Homme.')) or (c.title='Thème 1 : L’origine de la vie et l’évolution de la lignée humaine.' and l.title='Leçon 1 : L’origine de la vie.'))), lesson_counts as (select series_name,chapter_title,lesson_title,chapter_active,lesson_active,content_length,(select count(*) from public.exercises e where e.lesson_id=target_lessons.id) as exercise_count,(select count(*) from public.exercise_questions eq join public.exercises e on e.id=eq.exercise_id where e.lesson_id=target_lessons.id) as exercise_question_count,(select bool_and(not e.is_active and not e.is_published) from public.exercises e where e.lesson_id=target_lessons.id) as exercises_draft,(select count(*) from public.quizzes q where q.lesson_id=target_lessons.id) as quiz_count,(select count(*) from public.quiz_questions qq join public.quizzes q on q.id=qq.quiz_id where q.lesson_id=target_lessons.id) as quiz_question_count,(select count(*) from public.quiz_answers qa join public.quiz_questions qq on qq.id=qa.question_id join public.quizzes q on q.id=qq.quiz_id where q.lesson_id=target_lessons.id) as quiz_answer_count,(select bool_and(not q.is_active and not q.is_published) from public.quizzes q where q.lesson_id=target_lessons.id) as quizzes_draft from target_lessons), scientific_matches as (select count(*) as c_d_matching_titles from public.lessons l join public.chapters c on c.id=l.chapter_id join public.course_subject_offerings o on o.id=c.subject_offering_id join public.subjects sub on sub.id=o.subject_id join public.levels lv on lv.id=o.level_id join public.series s on s.id=o.series_id where sub.name='Sciences de la Vie et de la Terre' and lv.name='Terminale' and s.name in ('C','D') and l.title in ('Leçon 1 : Les réactions émotionnelles chez l’Homme.','Leçon 2 : L’activité cérébrale chez l’Homme.','Leçon 1 : L’origine de la vie.')) select jsonb_build_object('lessons',(select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(lesson_counts) order by series_name,chapter_title,lesson_title) from lesson_counts),'scientific_series',(select to_jsonb(scientific_matches) from scientific_matches)) as verification limit 1;
